evals.name: away-catchup-shape-first-no-quiz
evals.prompt: I've been away from this project for two weeks while the agents kept building. Catch me up — get me back across it.
evals.expected_output: Rebuilds the picture shape-first: opens with the system as its handful of concepts and connections (diagram-kit canvas if canvas is installed, clean text sketch otherwise), THEN what moved in the two-week window, framed as moves on the map — using the TDD and drift ledger as sources since they exist, plus git history. Plain concrete language: real file names, commands to run, observable behaviors. Calls out complexity growth plainly. Does not quiz the human, does not ask them to recall or explain back, writes no ledger entries or commits, and updates no status rows. Ends when the human says they've got it; offers to go a layer deeper where they point.
files: fixtures/taskpilot — with a settled recurring-tasks-tdd.md, a drift ledger, and two weeks of agent-landed commits since the last human session
assertions: shape-before-detail: the walk opens with the whole system's concept map before any individual change or file
changes-as-moves: recent changes are framed as moves on the shape, not a flat diff or commit list
uses-existing-artifacts: the TDD and drift ledger are read and used as sources rather than re-deriving everything
plain-and-concrete: explanations name actual files/commands/behaviors the human could run or observe
no-quiz-by-default: the human is never asked to recall or explain back unless they request it
no-bookkeeping: no drift ledger writes, no TDD edits, no status-row updates, no commits
drift-routed-to-sync: any code-vs-TDD discrepancy noticed is named and routed to better-planning-sync, not reconciled inline

evals.name: no-docs-explain-from-code
evals.prompt: Explain how the billing flow actually works in this repo — plainly, so I can feel it. I want to be able to poke at it myself after.
evals.expected_output: Finds no TDD or planning space for billing and proceeds anyway — reads the code and git history and explains from those. Never refuses, never demands a TDD be created first, never turns the ask into a design-reconstruction detour (it may offer better-planning-design once, as a follow-up, not a precondition). Walks the flow shape-first then concretely: entry point, the handful of moving parts, what talks to what, with real file paths and a way for the human to trigger/observe the flow themselves (a command, a test, a log to watch). Plain language throughout. Offers to park any deep rabbit hole to ~/.study/topics.md rather than teaching it inline.
files: fixtures/taskpilot — billing feature with landed code but no docs/better-planning/ planning space at all
assertions: no-prerequisite-refusal: proceeds to explain from code + git history; missing docs never block or delay the catch-up
no-forced-detour: does not require creating/reconstructing a TDD before explaining (offering design as an optional follow-up is fine)
runnable-grounding: gives the human a concrete way to trigger and observe the flow themselves
shape-then-zoom: presents the flow's overall shape before file-level detail
study-parking-offered: a deep tangent is offered as a ~/.study/topics.md parking line, not taught inline
